name: ondras/rot.js
description: ROguelike Toolkit in JavaScript modelled after libtcod, providing procedural generation, pathfinding, FOV, scheduling, and terminal display for browser-based roguelike development. The go-to choice for web roguelikes.
score_rationale: 2.7k-star JavaScript roguelike toolkit that enables browser-based roguelike development with feature parity to libtcod.
summary: Web-based roguelike toolkit with procedural generation and browser-native display
